name: ap_exception_packet
description: Extract the full AP exception packet from a vendor invoice so the exception can be triaged without a human opening the document
extractionInstructions: This is a vendor invoice that FAILED straight-through processing in the AP system. Extract every field needed to triage the exception. Pay special attention to: (1) the PO number, which may be printed anywhere on the page including in the header, footer, or a reference block, and may be prefixed 'PO', 'P.O.', 'Order', or 'Ref'; (2) remittance instructions, which may differ from the vendor's address of record and are a common fraud vector; (3) any handwritten or stamped annotations, which usually indicate a prior manual touch; (4) whether the invoice references a credit memo or is itself a credit. If a field is genuinely absent from the document, return null rather than guessing.

bdaSchema.description: Accounts-payable exception triage packet extracted from a vendor invoice
bdaSchema.extractionInstructions: Extract the invoice header, vendor identity, remittance instructions, line items, tax detail and any prior-touch annotations. Return null for absent fields. Never infer a PO number that is not printed on the document.

line_number.instruction: Sequential position of this line on the invoice, starting at 1

description.instruction: Full description of the product or service on this line

sku.instruction: Vendor part number, SKU, catalogue number, or item code for this line

uom.instruction: Unit of measure, e.g. EA, CS, BOX, HR, LB

unit_price.instruction: Price per unit for this line

amount.instruction: Extended amount for this line, normally quantity multiplied by unit_price

gl_code.instruction: General ledger account code if coded on the invoice

po_line_reference.instruction: Purchase order line number this invoice line refers to, if printed

annotation_type.instruction: One of: handwritten_note, stamp, highlight, signature, correction

location.instruction: Where on the page the annotation appears, e.g. header, near total, margin left

invoice_number.instruction: The vendor's unique invoice identifier exactly as printed, preserving any prefix, leading zeros, dashes or slashes

invoice_date.instruction: Date the invoice was issued, normalised to YYYY-MM-DD

due_date.instruction: Payment due date, normalised to YYYY-MM-DD. If only terms are stated, leave null and rely on payment_terms

po_number.instruction: Purchase order reference. Look in the header block, the reference block, the footer, and any 'Your Order' or 'Customer PO' field. Strip labels such as 'PO#' and return only the identifier. Return null if no PO is printed anywhere

receipt_number.instruction: Goods receipt, delivery note, packing slip, or GRN number if referenced on the invoice

payment_terms.instruction: Payment terms exactly as stated, e.g. NET30, NET45, 2/10 NET 30, Due on Receipt

currency.instruction: Three letter ISO currency code for all amounts on this invoice, e.g. USD, CAD, EUR

document_kind.instruction: One of: invoice, credit_memo, debit_memo, statement, prepayment_request. Determine from the document title and whether amounts are negative

vendor_name.instruction: Legal name of the vendor issuing the invoice, as printed in the letterhead

vendor_dba.instruction: Trading name or 'doing business as' name if different from vendor_name

vendor_address.instruction: Complete vendor address on a single line

vendor_country.instruction: Two letter ISO country code of the vendor address

vendor_tax_id.instruction: Vendor tax identifier: EIN, TIN, VAT number, GST number or BN

vendor_email.instruction: Vendor billing or accounts receivable email address

remit_to_name.instruction: Payee name in the remittance instructions, which may be a factoring company and differ from vendor_name

remit_to_address.instruction: Remittance address, lockbox, or PO box for payment

remit_bank_name.instruction: Bank name in the remittance instructions if wire or ACH details are printed

remit_account_last_four.instruction: Last four digits only of any bank account number printed on the document. Never return the full account number

bill_to_cost_center.instruction: Cost centre, department, business unit, or site code the invoice is billed to

requisitioner.instruction: Name of the person who requested the goods or services, often labelled Attn, Requested By, or Buyer

line_items.instruction: Every billed line on the invoice in the order printed. Do not merge lines and do not include subtotal or tax rows

subtotal.instruction: Net amount before tax, freight and other charges

freight_amount.instruction: Freight, shipping, delivery or handling charge stated separately from the line items

other_charges.instruction: Any other separately stated charge such as fuel surcharge, pallet fee, or small order fee

discount_amount.instruction: Discount or allowance applied on the face of the invoice, expressed as a positive number

tax_jurisdiction.instruction: Taxing jurisdiction or tax type printed, e.g. TX State Sales Tax, ON HST, VAT

tax_rate.instruction: Tax rate exactly as printed including the percent sign, e.g. 8.25%

tax_amount.instruction: Total tax charged on the invoice

total_amount.instruction: Grand total amount due on the invoice

prior_invoice_reference.instruction: Any referenced earlier invoice number, common on credit memos, rebills and corrected invoices

annotations.instruction: Handwritten notes, stamps, highlights and signatures visible on the document. These indicate a prior manual touch and are important triage evidence

is_duplicate_suspect.instruction: True if the document itself carries any indication it is a resubmission, such as the words DUPLICATE, COPY, SECOND NOTICE, REMINDER, or PAST DUE

math_is_internally_consistent.instruction: True if subtotal plus freight plus other charges minus discount plus tax equals total_amount within one cent

legibility.instruction: One of: clean_digital, good_scan, poor_scan, partially_illegible. Use poor_scan or partially_illegible when skew, noise or cropping is likely to have degraded extraction

extractionRules.redactionPolicy: Never emit a full bank account number. Emit last four digits only.

validationRules.name: line_extension_validation
validationRules.description: Each line amount must equal quantity multiplied by unit_price within one cent

validationRules.name: subtotal_validation
validationRules.description: Subtotal must equal the sum of all line amounts

validationRules.name: grand_total_validation
validationRules.description: Grand total must reconcile against subtotal, freight, other charges, discount and tax

validationRules.name: remit_party_drift
validationRules.description: Flag when the remit-to party differs from the vendor of record, a known payment redirection fraud pattern
